# PRD-BLD-03

**Are the automated fitness functions running in the delivery pipeline or continuously, and passing on the release candidate?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | BLD: As built |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `fitness_functions.automated`, `fitness_functions.runs`, `evidence` |

## Why it matters

A characteristic protected only on paper is not protected; production is where a fitness function starts to earn its place.

## Rule

Every fitness function with automated true has runs other than manual. A reviewer confirms from the pipeline or its evidence that they pass on the release candidate.

## Sources

- Ford, Parsons, Kua and Sadalage, Building Evolutionary Architectures, 2nd edition (2022) (`bea`)
- The Open Group, Open Agile Architecture Standard, Version 2.0 (C262), 11.3.2 and 11.3.3 (`oaa`)
